text:
kelly (AE): Cedar Labs wants a 3-week POC starting next Wed. Their procurement asks for a single committed monthly number, throughput sizing for ~9k peak rps (avg ~640 tokens), and explicit BYOK/HSM language. Also they want a fallback for AZ capacity loss.

noel (SE): finance insists on reserved capacity only. They rejected burst-only. Need 3 clean options and brief runbook for AZ eviction.

pavan (Solutions): quick sketch: baseline = 4 reserved GPUs (A40-class equivalent) w/ autoscale headroom to 6. For q8 quantization we can show a 1.6x throughput case (2-3 reserved), but mixed traffic makes quantized-only risky. Autoscale proposal: min=4, target_util=0.67, max=6, cooldown=120s. Prewarm: KV warmup + synthetic ramp.

kelly (AE): procurement wants monthly $ and a one-sentence tradeoff on p99 risk for each option.

pavan (Solutions): short bullets to include:
- 4 reserved (baseline): predictable spend, recommended p99 stability.
- 6 reserved (buffer): ~+40% cost, reduces queuing during sustained spikes.
- 2 reserved + preheat credits: ~-20% cost vs baseline but higher p99 risk and headroom limits.
I'll add exact numbers in the ticket.

anya (Security): questionnaire notes: CMK required, HSM wrapping requested, SOC2 evidence asked for, and 12mo audit log retention in eu-west-1. BYOK/HSM is enterprise add-on and needs legal addendum. Dedicated simplifies residency.

noel (SE): can you give a compact AZ-eviction fallback runbook? procurement likes explicit steps.

pavan (Solutions): runbook (short): 1) maintain 1-2 warm standby replicas in secondary AZ with KV snapshots; 2) on eviction alert, route new work to standby AZ and spin replicas up to max_replicas; 3) if GPU capacity exhausted, gracefully degrade to a smaller model variant (shorter tokens) and return a user-facing grace message; 4) post-recovery rehydrate KV caches.

kelly (AE): timeline: answers to questionnaire by Fri EOD, pricing sheet with three options by Mon, infra deploy Tue. Can the team meet that?

pavan (Solutions): yes. I'll open a ticket with pricing calc, autoscale YAML, prewarm script, and smoke test plan (0->9k rps over 12m capturing p50/p95/p99 and token_cost.csv). Example load command: `loadgen --target 9000 --ramp 720 --payload=chat_640.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv`.

ops_bot: created ticket SRV-24680 "Cedar Labs POC: reserved pricing + HSM addendum" assigned to pavan, due 2026-04-07. :white_check_mark:

kelly (AE): please call out quantized vs FP pricing bins and note legal for HSM addendum. I'll update the customer after we have the pricing sheet.

pavan (Solutions): will add quantized multipliers (q8 x1.6, q4 x1.3) and per-1k-response cost at 512/640 tokens. End of thread.
